note: Machine-readable capability inventory based on snapshot_sha; the immutable review SHA is recorded separately when the candidate is frozen. Every page route, API route, Server Action group, KPI definition, and provider connection must carry exactly one of: REAL_VERIFIED | REAL_PENDING_SECRET | PENDING_CONTRACT | TEST_ONLY | LEGACY_REMOVE

classifications_doc.REAL_VERIFIED: End-to-end verified by independent evidence with SHA-pinned artifacts. F1.1 is the only accepted basis.
classifications_doc.REAL_PENDING_SECRET: Code correct and honest; activation requires an environment secret not present in CI.
classifications_doc.PENDING_CONTRACT: Planned capability or quarantined route. Returns NOT_AVAILABLE or not yet implemented.
classifications_doc.TEST_ONLY: Dev/test tooling only. Must not appear in the production user journey.
classifications_doc.LEGACY_REMOVE: Known broken, fake, or demo-mode element. Scheduled for removal. Gate will detect as violation.
